selected16.identity_rule: The colon-key split_identity_hash proves receipt partition integrity. Runtime and protocol surfaces use the carrier-prefixed run identity, matching the G3 VerifiedSplit convention.

remainder24.contact_status: closed unless exactly one deterministically selected Stage-1 winner qualifies

C.label: G3 matched plain-English ground comparator
C.rule: Reuse the sealed G3 selected16 rows without model recontact; obtain any additional comparator metrics only by identity-filtering its sealed official whole-manifest score artifact.

E.label: sealed task-blind English OBS plus executable semantic microground
E.state_source: existing sealed G3 task-blind English observation
E.ground: the deterministic microground routed once per active action

SE.label: validated structured state plus executable semantic microground
SE.ground: the same deterministic microground policy and corpus used by E

microground.empty_active_actions_fallback: Only when validated active_actions is empty, issue exactly one task-blind query from current_request.normalized, falling back to current_request.surface. Do not infer an action and do not add tool, gold, sample, tier, reward, or prior-outcome features.
microground.selection: retain top two per active action plus the best sibling contrast or schema-compatible alternative; union two through eight unique registered candidates while preserving at least the top candidate for every active action
microground.render: selected cards plus exactly four task cards

stage1_execution.state_cap_scope: The 8192-byte cap applies only to prospective SE. Sealed E remains bound to the predecessor 4096-byte contract.
stage1_execution.state_preservation_rule: Preserve the complete exact ASCII surface and normalized values. Do not truncate, omit, summarize, or deduplicate state content to fit the cap.
stage1_execution.failure_rule: Seal available traces, abort the affected attempt, stop the flight, and do not recontact a row. Recovery requires a prospective amendment.
stage1_execution.score_open_rule: Seal both complete 16-row new-arm manifests before gold or official scores open.

stage1_gate_per_new_arm.paired_exact_improvement_over_C: wins minus losses must be strictly greater than zero on the same selected16 identities

required_effects: E minus C: executable-microground effect relative to the sealed G3 comparator
SE minus E: structured-state increment with the microground fixed
SE minus C: combined structured-state and executable-microground effect
mechanism_report.factorial_limit: There is no state-only cell. Report the three registered contrasts as a staged mechanism decomposition; do not claim a classical two-by-two interaction.

extension_rule.exactly_one_passes: Only that qualifying arm may contact remainder24.
extension_rule.both_pass: Choose exactly one extension arm by lexicographic order: higher exact count, then higher slot micro-F1, then higher parse count, then higher paired exact net gain; an exact tie selects E as the lower-complexity arm.

scoring.extension_job: one complete 40-row composite manifest for the deterministically selected arm
scoring.gold_rule: Gold remains scoring-side only and opens only after the relevant whole manifest seals.

supersession.scope: The dormant zero-contact 104-row full-handbook qualification must not launch. Its immutable registration and ledger history remain unchanged.

terminal_rules.stage1_failure: If neither E nor SE passes every primary condition, close G4 on this cohort and do not open remainder24, fresh88, test, pruning, scale, or training-free control.
terminal_rules.full40_pass: Freeze the qualifying ground as a Stage-2 discovery result. Any pruning or training-free control study requires a separate prospective contract and must preserve an untouched evaluation surface.
terminal_rules.full40_failure: Close this ground form without tuning on these returns. Any materially different ground requires a new prospective discovery registration.

prohibitions: No model, scorer, tokenizer, retriever-service, or network contact is authorized by this zero-contact artifact alone.
Do not use gold, references, test annotations, prior outcomes, future turns, or synthetic example literals as router queries.
Do not repair, retry, recontact, run jitter experiments, tune on test, prune candidates, fit training-free control, or scale from a failed gate.
